author: Offer Shina
description: A personal blog by Offer Shina about mitochondria and VDAC1 — the science, the news, and why a PSEN1 carrier can't stop reading about it.

hero.eyebrow: a personal mission — shared in the open
hero.titleHtml: What actually helps your mitochondria? I'm building the most useful answer I can.
hero.lead: I'm Offer. Understanding mitochondrial health isn't an academic hobby for me — it's a need. So I read the science obsessively and share what I learn here, graded honestly, to help others navigate it too. The goal is simple and a little audacious: build the largest, most helpful, evidence-rated guide to mitochondrial health anywhere — starting with the ratings below.
